da-non-sequitur.evidence: (S↔P column of cor:spectral-decomposition-qvalue row) Sibling `.lean:122` (ref resolves only there): `x · ∏_{τ∈E} F τ = x · F active` given `hInactive : ∀ τ ≠ active, F τ = 1`, i.e. `Finset.prod_eq_single` with the cancellation as hypothesis; F and E are arbitrary, and the decomposition Q = Q_bare·∏F, the case definition of F, and (v) exactness are not encoded (Q_bare only as a `def`). PR #7915 touches this `.md` (notation `𝔈 → 𝔈_int` only), not the issue. Narrative: (v) "The decomposition is exact. No higher-order corrections exist" (md:58) contradicts the block's own md:54, which says the fully-filled (Pauli) case gives F = 0, hence Q = 0 for every magic-number shell under convention D, and that "a replacement projection has not been derived"; the proof block adds that F_deg2 ≈ 3.68 > 1 "is not a proportion" and that the old 0.6382 Pauli value "is not reproduced" (prf:44,64). Proof step 1 (completeness of 𝓔_g as a basis of the representation ring "by Möbius inversion" and self-duality, prf:3,21) is asserted: six knots cannot span R(H_n(q)) for all n, and no orthogonality is computed
